title: Correctable part contributes nothing to the operator count
statement:
Let $p$ be prime and let $S$ be an $\mathbb{F}_p$-subspace of the symplectic space $V = \mathbb{F}_p^n \times \mathbb{F}_p^n$. Suppose $B$ and $C$ are disjoint subsets of the coordinate set $\{0,\dots,n-1\}$, and that $B$ is correctable for $S$. Then
\[
g(S,\, B \cup C) \;\le\; 2\lvert C\rvert,
\]
where $g(S,M) = \dim_{\mathbb{F}_p}\!\bigl(S^{\perp}_M\bigr) - \dim_{\mathbb{F}_p}\!\bigl(S_M\bigr)$.
replaced:
If $B$ and $C$ are disjoint and $B$ is correctable for $S$, then
$g(S, B \cup C) \le 2|C|$.
